newsitem.title: USA: Aetrium stock falls on earnings warnings.
newsitem.headline: Aetrium stock falls on earnings warnings.

text.p: The stock of Aetrium Inc. lost more than 20 percent of its value Monday after the maker of equipment used by the semiconductor industry to test integrated circuits said its results for the next two quarters will be well below Wall Street's estimates.
Aetrium fell $2.75 to $10.25 on the Nasdaq market.

The St. Paul, Minn.-based company said it expects third-quarter revenues of $13 million and earnings per share of between 18 cents and 21 cents, down from the average Wall Street estimate of 38 cents a share.
Aetrium said it also expects revenue and earnings will be significantly below current analysts' expectations for the fourth quarter, which ends on Dec. 31.
It posted earnings of 72 cents a share in the first six months of 1996 on revenues of $34.3 million. Aetrium said it plans to report its third-quarter results in mid-October.
The company said a slump in the semiconductor industry has deepened.

The company said that during the current quarter customers had put off taking delivery of some orders until later in the year and other orders were cancelled due to a downturn in the semiconductor industry.
